description: Two anomalies: one ongoing, one closed with zero expected spend.
speech: AWS Cost Anomaly Detection reported 2 anomalies between October 8 and October 15. The largest: Amazon Simple Storage Service cost 7.20 USD against an expected 0.80 USD, 6.40 USD above the baseline (800.0% higher). AWS still reports it as ongoing. AWS last evaluated your costs on October 14.

report.currency_basis: documented_not_returned: the Cost Anomaly Detection API returns impact amounts without a currency field; AWS's Impact documentation describes them as dollar values
